Name: Wash Your Chicken
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Sick of all that yummy tasting food in the game and all the mods you see? Wish you could have food that tastes and looks way worse? Now you can!

To wash chicken, make sure you have soapstone in your inventory and left click on your sink (or any tile that has water) while holding raw chicken. You'll get squeaky clean washed chicken!

Then, you can boil your chicken! Boiled chicken is a recipe passed down in the farmer's family, so you enter the valley knowing it already!

Some NPCs have custom responses when gifted Boiled Chicken, so go crazy! Show off your cooking skills to the whole village!

(washing chicken irl not recommended. on account of its not foodsafe)
